messages:
mira: Deploybot flagged a compatibility delta for quant-v5b on runtime 2.18 in ap-southeast-1 during long-context runs. proposing a regional soft-pin + float fallback to buy triage time. :warning:
deploybot: ALERT: compatibility-check failure -> model=quant-v5b, runtime=2.18, region=ap-southeast-1. Observed: 4.6% checksum mismatches on sequences >4096. Suggested action: apply regional soft-pin to runtime:2.17 for new sessions.
tony: can someone paste the smallest failing log lines? need to know if it's kvcache or memory ordering.
mira: log snippet from the harness attached: 
```
[2026-07-12T14:02:11Z] runtime-2.18 kernelA: kvcache evict_index mismatch shard=7 expected=16384 got=16368
[2026-07-12T14:02:11Z] model quant-v5b: attention_state checksum mismatch
```
eng-runtime: assigning runtime team to investigate. early hypothesis: eviction + async prefetch race when sequence wraps a 4096 window. will instrument semaphore traces in harness.
docs: if we keep a soft-pin >12h product needs a changelog line and a short customer FYI. @support prepare canned replies.
sre-oncall: routing to f32-fallback will bump APAC 95p latency ~45-70ms and increase token cost ~1.9x. I'll add alerts: ap-southeast-1 quant-v5b errors >1% for 5m -> pager; 95p latency >180ms -> pager.
mira: plan: 1) apply regional soft-pin (12h) 2) route new sessions to f32-fallback only 3) eng-runtime reproduce + patch 4) test fix in eu-canary 5) lift pin when green.
tony: +1 regional only. global rollback is last resort.
deploybot: EXEC: pin add --scope region --region ap-southeast-1 --target runtime:2.17 --model quant-v5b --mode soft --ttl 12h --reason "kvcache evict_index mismatch on longseq"
deploybot: Pin applied -> pin_id=pin_4622223344. New sessions in ap-southeast-1 will prefer runtime:2.17 for quant-v5b. Auto-unpin TTL=12h unless extended. Audit: user=mira.
eng-runtime: starting instrumented run now. ETA deterministic repro ~2.5h if hypothesis holds. will post PR id for kernel fix if found.
sre-oncall: prepping a 10% f32 fallback pool and autoscale runway. ETA ~20m. added cost and latency dashboards.
docs: drafting changelog blurb: "APAC: temporary routing to float fallback for quant-v5b on long contexts; regional soft-pin applied." will share shortly.
support: canned reply draft: "We're routing APAC requests for quant-v5b to a float-compatible variant to ensure correctness for long contexts. Expect modest latency increases; no action needed from customers."
mira: setting owner=eng-runtime for triage. will update this thread with repro status or if metrics spike. please @mention for urgent changes. :white_check_mark:
